title: Budget settlement reconciliation
description: Objective: settle active reservations with the honest measurement records from task-5ee5b801127a4536a6e770abc6e83e9e while preserving the hierarchical ledger from task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4. Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.ts, its one-line .js bridge, and focused tests for exact settlement/refund, partial or unknown quarantine, never-started proof, conservative write-off, explicit overrun, reconciliation, and legal account closure. NOT in scope: provider adapters, billing APIs, policy decisions after unknown liability, supersession funding, persistence, or package-root export. Hard dependencies: tasks task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4, task-318c0732094c417f96932b5c83e7388b, and task-5ee5b801127a4536a6e770abc6e83e9e must be DONE unchanged. Owned paths: budget-settlement.ts, budget-settlement.js, budget-settlement.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: A complete correlated measurement commits exact use, refunds only the proven remainder, and is duplicate-safe; measured use above reservation creates explicit overrun liability and OVERDRAWN state without negative buckets or sibling funding.
PARTIAL commits only its proven lower bound and quarantines the unresolved remainder; UNKNOWN quarantines the reservation and never writes zero committed usage.
Proof that an effect never started refunds every refundable reservation while any already-committed attempt.count remains committed.

Conservative settlement commits the full held reservation as CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF; when no enforceable upper bound existed it also records persistent UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_LIABILITY and closes only as CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY.
No account closes with RESERVED or QUARANTINED units; stale, out-of-order, conflicting, or illegal reconciliation has zero effect with frozen deterministic issues.
Both TypeScript files are <=250 physical lines, the bridge is one exact re-export line, and the focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Do not modify predecessor modules/tests; compose only their public internal-budget exports.
The four design quarantine exits are closed; no generic refund/forgive path and no conversion of unknown external liability to exact spend.
Production and test TypeScript files must each be <=250 physical lines; stage only the three explicit owned paths.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED, part A — create packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.test.ts with builders and acceptance-path specs (budget ~125 lines; WHOLE FILE must end <=250 physical lines, so keep builders dense). Builders: mkView(meters overrides), mkActivated(reservation in state ACTIVATED with attemptRef 'run-1', lines built via reserveForAdmission conventions or hand literals), mkMeasurement(coverage, quantity, sequence, providerRunRef default 'run-1', meter) wrapping a valid NormalizedMeasurement literal (64-hex rawReceiptDigest). expectConserved(before, after, overrunTotal) pins the DESIGN EQUATION (610-613): for each meter, after.available+after.reserved+after.quarantined+after.committed === before sum + overrun for that meter — measured excess above the hold ENTERS COMMITTED and is ALSO recorded as explicit overrun, which is what balances the equation. Acceptance specs: (1) exact settle: COMPLETE qty < hold commits qty RESERVED->COMMITTED, refunds remainder RESERVED->AVAILABLE, settlement.state SETTLED, disposition EXACT, view.version+1; (2) duplicate-safe: replay with prior=first settlement and byte-identical inputs returns the PRIOR record BY REFERENCE (toBe) and moves nothing; (3) overrun: COMPLETE qty > hold commits FULL measured qty into COMMITTED (hold from RESERVED + excess minted against explicit overrun), overrun array carries exactly the excess, view.state OVERDRAWN, NO bucket negative, an untouched sibling meter's buckets byte-equal before/after (no sibling funding); (4) PARTIAL commits lower bound, quarantines remainder RESERVED->QUARANTINED, state QUARANTINED, disposition LOWER_BOUND; (5) UNKNOWN coverage (and separately: a reserved meter with NO measurement) quarantines the whole hold, commits ZERO units with disposition UNKNOWN_HELD — assert no COMMITTED movement happened, never a zero-committed EXACT; (6) reconcile receipt path: quarantined settlement + later COMPLETE receipt with sequence advancing past the stored line sequence commits exact from QUARANTINED, refunds proven remainder QUARANTINED->AVAILABLE, state SETTLED; (7) reconcile never-started path: neverStartedProofRef refunds every quarantined unit QUARANTINED->AVAILABLE while a pre-existing committed attempt.count bucket amount on the view stays byte-identical (assert the committed field unchanged); (8) conservativeSettle with acknowledgementRef + enforceableUpperBound:true commits ALL quarantined units as disposition CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF, refunds nothing, state WRITTEN_OFF, unknownExternalLiability false; (9) same with enforceableUpperBound:false additionally sets persistent unknownExternalLiability:true; (10) closeSettledView on a drained OPEN view (all meters available=0,reserved=0,quarantined=0; committed may be >0) with settlements carrying no liability yields state CLOSED; with any supplied settlement carrying unknownExternalLiability:true yields CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY — never plain CLOSED (DoD 4).

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED, part B — extend budget-settlement.test.ts with the table-driven rejection matrix and meta tests (file total <=250 lines; copy the 17.02/17.03 density pattern: one row per case, shared runner asserting for every row a SINGLE one-element issue array with the exact expected code, Object.isFrozen(result) and frozen issue, result.view toBe the input view (zero effect, same reference), and for ops carrying a settlement that the input settlement object is unmutated). Matrix rows, minimum: MALFORMED (hostile/extra-key cmd, non-record measurement, negative expectedVersion); IDENTITY_MISMATCH (reservation.reservationId not matching deriveReservationId(accountId, admissionRef), and accountId != view.accountId); NOT_ACTIVATED (settle on state RESERVED and on CANCELLED); ALREADY_SETTLED (settle with prior of same reservationId but DIFFERENT bytes; reconcile/conservative on state SETTLED and WRITTEN_OFF); STALE_VERSION (view version mismatch; settlement version mismatch — both ops); COUNTER_EXHAUSTED (view.version >= MAX_BUDGET_VERSION); UNCORRELATED_MEASUREMENT (measurement.providerRunRef !== reservation.attemptRef); UNKNOWN_METER (measurement meter not among reservation line meters; reconcile receipt meter not quarantined in settlement); DUPLICATE_METER (two measurements same meter in one call); INSUFFICIENT_RESERVED / INSUFFICIENT_QUARANTINED (view buckets below the reservation/settlement totals — tampered or foreign view); MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT (reconcile receipt qty BELOW the already-committed lower bound; never-started proof against a settlement whose any line committed > 0); SEQUENCE_STALE (reconcile receipt sequence <= stored line sequence); EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS (reconcile with both measurements and neverStartedProofRef non-null, and with both null); ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_MISSING (conservativeSettle without acknowledgementRef); ILLEGAL_CLOSE (close with reserved>0; with quarantined>0; with available>0; view.state OVERDRAWN; view.state already CLOSED; a supplied settlement still state QUARANTINED). Meta tests: (a) coverage — the set of codes asserted across the matrix EQUALS the exported BUDGET_SETTLEMENT_ISSUE_CODES exactly, so an uncovered code fails the suite; (b) every acceptance spec from part A runs expectConserved; (c) each row asserts the case was actually generated (non-empty matrix guard, per epic rail).

do not hand-write messages); (3) SETTLEMENT_STATES = ['QUARANTINED','SETTLED','WRITTEN_OFF'], LINE_DISPOSITIONS = ['EXACT','LOWER_BOUND','UNKNOWN_HELD','CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF','NEVER_STARTED_REFUND']; (4) types: SettlementLine {meter, reserved, committed, refunded, quarantined, disposition, identity: string|null, sequence: number|null} (identity/sequence of the settling measurement, consulted by reconcile ordering); SettlementRecord {settlementId, reservationId, accountId, attemptRef, version, state, lines, unknownExternalLiability: boolean, overrun: readonly {meter,amount}[]}; deriveSettlementId(reservationId) = `settlement:${reservationId.length}:${reservationId}` (length-prefixed, injective); BudgetSettlementResult = {ok:true, settlement, view} | {ok:false, settlement: SettlementRecord|null, view, issues} — refusal returns the caller's view BY REFERENCE, deepFrozen result, single first-failing-check code via ordered Check tables; (5) local private clones: deepFreeze, isCount, isRef, firstOf, readRecord (unavoidable — siblings do not export them); (6) settleReservation(view, reservation, evidence {measurements: readonly NormalizedMeasurement[]}, cmd {expectedViewVersion, expectedReservationVersion, prior: SettlementRecord|null}): guards in pinned order malformed > identity (deriveReservationId recheck + accountId===view.accountId) > not-activated > duplicate/already-settled (prior same reservationId: byte-identical full inputs return PRIOR BY REFERENCE as ok; different bytes refuse ALREADY_SETTLED) > stale versions > counter exhausted > uncorrelated (each measurement.measurement.providerRunRef === reservation.attemptRef) > duplicate meter > unknown meter (measurement meter must be in reservation totals) > insufficient reserved. Per-meter disposition over totalPerMeter(reservation.lines) recomputed locally: COMPLETE qty<=hold commits qty, refunds hold-qty; COMPLETE qty>hold commits the FULL measured qty into COMMITTED (the hold from RESERVED plus the excess minted against an explicit overrun entry {meter, amount: qty-hold}) and sets view.state OVERDRAWN — the conservation equation (design 610-613) balances because bucket sum grows by exactly the recorded overrun; PARTIAL commits qty (lower bound), quarantines hold-qty; UNKNOWN or missing measurement quarantines the full hold with committed 0 and disposition UNKNOWN_HELD (never a zero-committed EXACT — that would launder unknown to zero). Record state QUARANTINED iff any line quarantined>0 else SETTLED; view.version+1; no bucket may go negative anywhere.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN part 1: budget-settlement.ts created with the 16 closed BUDGET_SETTLEMENT_ codes (messages derived from the code string, no hand-written prose), SETTLEMENT_STATES, LINE_DISPOSITIONS, the record/line/command types, private clones of deepFreeze/isCount/isRef/oneOf/firstOf/readRecord (none are exported by any sibling), and settleReservation. Two deviations from the plan text, both deliberate and both smaller than the alternative: (1) the per-meter engine is ONE function `dispose(meter, hold, credited, from, reading)` shared by settle and reconcile, because a reconcile receipt quantity is the TOTAL measured use for that meter, so the committed delta is quantity - credited and settle is just the credited=0 case; this is also what makes MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT (receipt below the committed lower bound) expressible at all. (2) The prior/ALREADY_SETTLED comparison is byte-identity against the freshly computed candidate, so it necessarily runs LAST rather than mid-table — a byte-identical replay returns the caller's prior record by reference with the caller's view by reference, any other prior refuses. Published settle precedence: MALFORMED > IDENTITY_MISMATCH > NOT_ACTIVATED > COUNTER_EXHAUSTED > STALE_VERSION > UNCORRELATED > DUPLICATE_METER > UNKNOWN_METER > INSUFFICIENT_RESERVED > ALREADY_SETTLED. Record state is stateOf(lines): SETTLED only when every line has quarantined 0 AND a resolved disposition (EXACT / CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF / NEVER_STARTED_REFUND), so a PARTIAL line whose remainder happens to be zero still reads QUARANTINED rather than silently closing an unresolved measurement. Overrun: measured excess enters COMMITTED and is recorded in settlement.overrun, view.state becomes OVERDRAWN, and the conservation equation balances by exactly that amount. Typecheck clean.

implementationPlan.description: GREEN, part 2 — same file, staying <=250 physical lines total: (7) reconcileSettlement(view, settlement, evidence {measurements: readonly NormalizedMeasurement[]|null, neverStartedProofRef: string|null}, cmd {expectedViewVersion, expectedSettlementVersion}): exactly one evidence arm non-null else EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS; settlement.state must be QUARANTINED else ALREADY_SETTLED; stale/counter guards as above. Receipt arm: per measurement, meter must be a quarantined line (UNKNOWN_METER), providerRunRef must equal settlement.attemptRef (UNCORRELATED_MEASUREMENT), sequence must advance strictly past the stored line sequence (SEQUENCE_STALE), qty below the line's already-committed lower bound is MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT; commits exact from QUARANTINED->COMMITTED, refunds proven remainder QUARANTINED->AVAILABLE, excess above quarantined follows the same explicit-overrun+OVERDRAWN rule as settle. Never-started arm: any line with committed>0 contradicts never-started -> MEASUREMENT_CONFLICT; otherwise every quarantined unit refunds QUARANTINED->AVAILABLE with disposition NEVER_STARTED_REFUND; COMMITTED buckets are never touched (already-committed attempt.count stays spent, design exit 2). Resulting state SETTLED when no quarantined units remain. (8) conservativeSettle(view, settlement, cmd {expectedViewVersion, expectedSettlementVersion, acknowledgementRef: string, enforceableUpperBound: boolean}): acknowledgementRef must be a non-empty bounded ref else ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_MISSING (design line 1039: conservative settlement requires human acknowledgement — model it as a required evidence ref exactly like 17.03 models approvals; no policy re-evaluation); state QUARANTINED required; commits ALL quarantined units QUARANTINED->COMMITTED, disposition CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF, refunds NOTHING (design exit 3); enforceableUpperBound===false additionally sets persistent unknownExternalLiability:true (design exit 4 — never represented as exact spend); result state WRITTEN_OFF. (9) closeSettledView(view, settlements: readonly SettlementRecord[], cmd {expectedVersion}): shape-checks every supplied settlement; refuses ILLEGAL_CLOSE unless view.state===OPEN AND every meter has available===0 && reserved===0 && quarantined===0 (design 664: no account closes with RESERVED or QUARANTINED units; available must be returned to the parent by the ledger first; OVERDRAWN close refused — the design gives OVERDRAWN no exit here and continuing after overrun is a human policy decision) AND no supplied settlement is state QUARANTINED; terminal state is CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY iff ANY supplied settlement carries unknownExternalLiability:true, else CLOSED — the linkage is structural (record in, state out), with the caveat that a pure module cannot force the caller to supply every settlement (same class of limitation as 17.03's at-most-one caveat; document it in the header, one line). Also document in the header: SETTLING is deliberately unused here (it is a ledger-level lifecycle needing account-wide knowledge this narrow view lacks). Every unit-moving op bumps view.version by exactly 1.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN part 2 landed in the same file; final size exactly 250 physical lines, typecheck clean, focused suite 45/45. reconcileSettlement, conservativeSettle and closeSettledView share one preamble `openQuarantine(view, settlement, cmd, extra)` that re-reads the settlement (readSettlement re-derives settlementId from reservationId so a forgery cannot transition), requires state QUARANTINED (else ALREADY_SETTLED), runs the op-specific extra checks, then the shared version fence, then INSUFFICIENT_QUARANTINED — that extraction is what made three ops fit under the cap. reconcile: exactly one evidence arm (EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS when both or neither); receipt arm checks correlation against settlement.attemptRef, duplicate meter, meter-must-be-a-quarantined-line, strictly advancing sequence, and receipt-below-committed-lower-bound, then commits qty - alreadyCommitted out of QUARANTINED, refunds the proven remainder to AVAILABLE, and mints explicit overrun + OVERDRAWN on excess exactly like settle; never-started arm refuses when any line already committed and otherwise moves QUARANTINED -> AVAILABLE only, so COMMITTED (the design-exit-2 attempt.count) is provably untouched. conservativeSettle requires acknowledgementRef AND the boolean bound classification as ONE evidence requirement (recovery matrix 1039 names both), commits every quarantined unit as CONSERVATIVE_WRITE_OFF, refunds nothing, sets state WRITTEN_OFF, and ORs in persistent unknownExternalLiability when the bound was unenforceable. closeSettledView refuses unless state OPEN and every meter has available+reserved+quarantined === 0 and no supplied settlement is still QUARANTINED (so OVERDRAWN and already-CLOSED both refuse), and picks CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY structurally from the supplied records rather than from a caller flag. Every op routes movement through one `shift()` that bumps view.version by exactly 1, including close. Documented limitation, same class as 17.03's: a pure module cannot force the caller to hand close every settlement of the account.

implementationPlan.description: MUTATION RED-CHECK + adversarial review (epic rail: failure-path tests must be proven able to go red). Before mutating, read Serena memories gotcha-mutation-testing-restore-safety and gotcha-mutation-harness-windows-decode and follow their restore rules: copy the pristine file OUT of the tree first, restore by copy, verify with git hash-object that the restored blob matches the committed/pristine hash after EVERY mutation. Mutations, each must turn the suite red: (1) overrun branch commits only the hold (drops the excess) — conservation + overrun tests red; (2) UNKNOWN disposition writes committed=qty??0 (zero-commit laundering) — DoD 2 tests red; (3) correlation guard removed (accept any providerRunRef) — UNCORRELATED matrix row red; (4) unknownExternalLiability never set on enforceableUpperBound:false — liability + close tests red; (5) close legality drops the quarantined===0 conjunct — ILLEGAL_CLOSE rows red; (6) duplicate no-op returns a rebuilt {...prior} instead of the prior reference — toBe duplicate test red; (7) ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_MISSING guard removed — that row red; (8) never-started arm also refunds COMMITTED — attempt.count-intact test red. Record each mutation and its red count for complete_task evidence. Adversarial checklist: two competitors settling the same reservation from the same stale view (pure-function caveat: the version fence plus prior mechanism is the compare-and-swap seam, the store enforces at-most-one — assert the loser refuses when applied to the winner's successor artifacts); hostile measurement objects with prototype-carried keys; empty measurements array (must not silently settle as all-UNKNOWN without quarantining — decide and test: empty array quarantines every hold, which is the fail-closed reading); -0 and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER quantities; a reservation whose lines sum above the view's reserved bucket.
implementationPlan.note: MUTATION RED-CHECK: 12 mutations, 12 RED, zero survivors. planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (a) Extending ReservationRecord with a SETTLED state — impossible: RESERVATION_STATES is a closed frozen union in the unowned 17.03 file; settlement therefore mints its own SettlementRecord and fences duplicates via a caller-supplied prior (the 17.04 purity pattern). (b) Per-meter incremental settlement calls — rejected for line budget and because design 655 treats the reservation as the settling unit; one-shot settle with per-meter dispositions is smaller and matches 'uncertain terminal usage moves the unresolved reservation to QUARANTINED'. (c) Bare liabilityRefs input to close — rejected by adversarial review: close takes the SettlementRecords themselves so the path-4 CLOSED_WITH_UNKNOWN_LIABILITY linkage is structural, not caller discipline. (d) Merging never-started refund into cancelReservation — wrong layer: cancel handles RESERVED-state pre-activation; settlement's never-started arm is design exit 2 on QUARANTINED holds, folded into reconcileSettlement because design 1038 names one budget.reconcile verb with two evidence forms.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: All four siblings land at 249-250 lines — the cap is the binding constraint. Compactions that made 17.03 fit and are mandated here: issue messages DERIVED from the code string, ordered Check tuple tables with firstOf deciding a single reported code, shared transition guard. deepFreeze/isCount/isRef/readRecord are private in every sibling and must be re-cloned (~40 lines). Refusals return the caller's view BY REFERENCE (tests assert toBe, so a rebuilt-equal object fails). Every unit-moving op bumps view.version by 1. Correlation fact: measurement.measurement.providerRunRef === reservation.attemptRef (attemptRef bound at activation). package-boundary scan skips the scheduler subtree entirely — no literal-scan constraint on these files. Overrun conservation reading pinned by design 610-613: measured excess enters COMMITTED and is simultaneously recorded as explicit overrun, which is exactly what keeps AVAILABLE+RESERVED+QUARANTINED+COMMITTED = authorized + recorded overrun balanced; an under-committed reading breaks the equation and expectConserved must be written to catch it.
planningNotes.risks: 250-line cap is HIGH RISK: this surface (4 ops, 5 dispositions, 16 codes, 5 bucket movements, hostile-input settlement reader) exceeds 17.03's, which landed at 249 — header must stay <=12 lines and density is not optional; report_blocked beats a fourth file. Pure-function concurrency caveat (from 17.03): two callers settling from the same stale view both succeed in isolation; the version fence + prior mechanism is the CAS seam and the store enforces at-most-one — do not 'fix' this with hidden state. UNKNOWN must never appear as zero committed spend; PARTIAL commits only the proven lower bound. conservativeSettle requires acknowledgementRef (design 1039 human acknowledgement) — omitting it was caught as a blocker in pre-verification. OVERDRAWN and QUARANTINED-settlement views refuse close; SETTLING is deliberately unused at this layer. Do not modify any predecessor budget file or export from the package root.
